## Objective

Assess performance of fragment model. 


### Assess tuning set
#### Input
-*labl_2020_tuning_fragments_reviewed.xlsx* (fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/)
List of fragments manually reviewed. Examples of classes are here:
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1iwTvRggTpLgBiylU861lNOKbjS_VIrJVO9CK5awc4l8/edit?usp=sharing

#### Output
- *single_metrics_labl_2020_tuning.json*
Performance metrics for detecting single fragments
- *duplicate_metrics_labl_2020_tuning.json*
Performance metrics for detecting duplicates 
- *corrected_fragments_labl_2020_tuning.json* 
List of fragments with duplicate classification corrected - can be used as a "human-in-the-loop" alternative for downstreams processing

### Issues/Deviations/Comments
The tuning_labl_2020 set was used for setting thresholds for the fragment model and the performance in it should thus be taken with a grain of salt. 
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)

reviewed <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab//fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/labl_2020_tuning_fragments_reviewed.xlsx")

output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/output/validate_fragments/"


#Calculate metrics for duplicate identification

reviewed_duplicate <- reviewed %>%
  mutate(duplicates_confusion = case_when(classification == "duplicate_fragment" & is.na(correction) ~ "TP",
                                          classification != "duplicate_fragment" & is.na(correction) ~ "TN",
                                          classification == "duplicate_fragment" & correction == "included_fragment" ~ "FP",
                                          classification != "duplicate_fragment" & correction == "duplicate" ~ "FN",
                                          TRUE ~ NA))

# Filter out NAs
filtered <- reviewed_duplicate[!is.na(reviewed_duplicate$duplicates_confusion), ]

# Create confusion matrix counts
TP <- sum(filtered$duplicates_confusion == "TP")
TN <- sum(filtered$duplicates_confusion == "TN")
FP <- sum(filtered$duplicates_confusion == "FP")
FN <- sum(filtered$duplicates_confusion == "FN")

# Compute metrics
sensitivity <- TP / (TP + FN)
specificity <- TN / (TN + FP)
ppv <- TP / (TP + FP)  # Positive Predictive Value
npv <- TN / (TN + FN)  # Negative Predictive Value
balanced_accuracy <- (sensitivity + specificity) / 2
f1_score <- 2 * TP / (2 * TP + FP + FN)

# Create a result table
duplicate_metrics <- data.frame(
  Sensitivity = sensitivity,
  Specificity = specificity,
  PPV = ppv,
  NPV = npv,
  Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
  F1_Score = f1_score
)

write_json(duplicate_metrics, paste0(output_dir, "duplicate_metrics_labl_2020_tuning.json"), pretty = TRUE)

fragments_corrected <- reviewed_duplicate%>%
  mutate(classification = case_when(correction == "duplicate" ~ "duplicate_fragment",
                                    correction == "included_fragment" ~ "included_fragment",
                                    is.na(correction) ~ classification,
                                    TRUE ~ NA)) %>%
  select(image_name, fragment_name, classification, fragment_area_um2, comment)

write_json(fragments_corrected, paste0(output_dir, "corrected_fragments_labl_2020_tuning.json"), pretty=TRUE)

fragments_corrected_single <- fragments_corrected %>%
  mutate(single_confusion = case_when(is.na(comment) ~ "TP",
                                     comment == "missed" ~ "FN",
                                     (comment == "split" | comment == "multiple" | comment == "part") ~ "FP",
                                     TRUE ~ NA))

filtered <- fragments_corrected_single %>% filter(classification == "included_fragment")

TP <- sum(filtered$single_confusion == "TP")
FP <- sum(filtered$single_confusion == "FP")
FN <- sum(filtered$single_confusion == "FN")

sensitivity <- TP / (TP + FN)
ppv <- TP / (TP + FP)  # Positive Predictive Value
f1_score <- 2 * TP / (2 * TP + FP + FN)

single_metrics <- data.frame(
  Sensitivity = sensitivity,
  PPV = ppv,
  F1_Score = f1_score
)

write_json(single_metrics, paste0(output_dir, "single_metrics_labl_2020_tuning.json"), pretty = TRUE)

```


### Assess full set
No output files - results printed here
```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

subset_training <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_labl_2020_training.json") %>%
  filter(use_batch_labl_2020 == 1 | use_batch_labl_2020 == 2 | use_batch_labl_2020 == 3)
subset_tuning <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_labl_2020_tuning.json")
subset_test <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_labl_2020_test.json")

reviewed_fragments_b0 <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/grading_sample_fragments_reviewed.xlsx") %>%
  select(image_name:corrected_classification)

reviewed_fragments_b1 <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/batch_1_fragments_reviewed.xlsx") %>%
  select(image_name:corrected_classification)

reviewed_fragments_b2 <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/batch_2_fragments_reviewed.xlsx") %>%
  select(image_name:corrected_classification)

reviewed_fragments_b3 <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/batch_3_fragments_reviewed.xlsx") %>%
  select(image_name:corrected_classification)

reviewed_fragments_b4 <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/batch_4_fragments_reviewed.xlsx") %>%
  select(image_name:corrected_classification)

reviewed_fragments_b5 <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/batch_5_fragments_reviewed.xlsx") %>%
  select(image_name:corrected_classification)

reviewed_fragments_b6 <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments_reviewed/batch_6_fragments_reviewed.xlsx") %>%
  select(image_name:corrected_classification)

reviewed_fragments_all <- bind_rows(reviewed_fragments_b0, reviewed_fragments_b1, reviewed_fragments_b2, reviewed_fragments_b3, reviewed_fragments_b4, reviewed_fragments_b5, reviewed_fragments_b6) %>%
  filter(!image_name  %in% subset_training$image_name) %>%
  filter(!image_name  %in% subset_tuning$image_name) %>%
  mutate(confusion_class = case_when(
    (classification == "duplicate_fragment" & is.na(corrected_classification)) ~ "TP",
    (classification == "duplicate_fragment" & corrected_classification == "original_fragment") ~ "FP",
    (classification == "original_fragment" & corrected_classification == "duplicate_fragment") ~ "FN",
    (classification == "original_fragment" & is.na(corrected_classification)) ~ "TN",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_))

test_images <- unique(reviewed_fragments_all$image_name)


confusion_counts <- table(reviewed_fragments_all$confusion_class)

TP <- confusion_counts["TP"]
TN <- confusion_counts["TN"]
FP <- confusion_counts["FP"]
FN <- confusion_counts["FN"]


ppv <- if ((TP + FP) > 0) TP / (TP + FP) else NA_real_
se  <- if ((TP + FN) > 0) TP / (TP + FN) else NA_real_
sp  <- if ((TN + FP) > 0) TN / (TN + FP) else NA_real_
npv <- if ((TN + FN) > 0) TN / (TN + FN) else NA_real_
balanced_accuracy <- if (!is.na(se) && !is.na(sp)) (se + sp) / 2 else NA_real_
f1_score <- if (!is.na(ppv) && !is.na(se) && (ppv + se) > 0) {
  2 * (ppv * se) / (ppv + se)
} else {
  NA_real_
}

print(
  paste0(
    "PPV is: ", ppv,
    "\nSe is: ", se,
    "\nSp is: ", sp,
    "\nNPV is: ", npv,
    "\nBalanced accuracy is: ", balanced_accuracy,
    "\nF1 is: ", f1_score
  )
)

```
